stories.title: Flintshire Catholic super-school consultation rejected by 96% for second time
stories.summary: A second statutory consultation on plans to close and merge four Catholic schools in Flintshire has drawn 2,813 responses, with around 96 per cent opposed to every element of the proposal. stories.summary: Plaid Cymru has signed a new agreement with the SNP and Sinn Féin pledging closer cooperation on areas of shared interest, including renewable energy, the economy and strengthened relations with Europe. stories.title: Roadworks: what’s happening on Flintshire’s roads this week
stories.summary: Drivers across Flintshire and Deeside face a number of road closures and temporary traffic lights this week, with several new schemes starting. stories.title: Nine-bedroom holiday let approved for barns at Rhydymwyn farm
stories.summary: Redundant barns at a farm near Mold have been approved for conversion into a nine-bedroom holiday let. Flintshire County Council’s planning committee approved the application for Tyddyn Y Gwynt Farm, Rhydymwyn, on 11 September. The application was submitted by agents Paterson Macaulay & Owens Ltd.
